title: Gleichlaut drafting items
description: Input of `gleichlaut draft --items FILE` and `gleichlaut month --items FILE`: a JSON array of items (or JSON Lines, one item per line). One item = one German amendment of one limitation text x one target language. Fields not listed here are allowed and carried through unchanged. Validated with the stdlib validator in gleichlaut/cli.py (keywords used here only: type, required, properties, enum, minLength, maxLength, minimum, maximum, pattern, minItems, items).

key.description: Unique within the file, stable across re-runs (records are resumed by key), no whitespace. `gleichlaut month` uses <CUD id>-<6 hex of the DE pair>-<lang>; Fedlex items use <act path>#<paragraph>|<lang>.

de_old.description: German limitation text before the amendment (as published).

de_new.description: German limitation text after the amendment.

tgt_old.description: Current French / Italian text of the same limitation (the text that is amended).

tgt_new.description: OPTIONAL, shadow mode only: the French / Italian text BAG already published for de_new. Never shown to the model; used only to score the draft (shadow_exact). Leave it out in pre-publication use.

change_ratio.description: OPTIONAL: share of German tokens changed (sl.mine.change_ratio). Computed when missing. > 0.6 routes the item to a human.

de_ratio.description: OPTIONAL, legacy name of change_ratio (research item files).

mpd.description: OPTIONAL: MedicinalProductDefinition id in the ePL feed.

cud_old.description: OPTIONAL: ClinicalUseDefinition id of the old limitation (ePL feed id).

cud_new.description: OPTIONAL: ClinicalUseDefinition id of the new limitation; used by the FHIR emitter.

snap_old.description: OPTIONAL: feed date (YYYYMMDD) of de_old / tgt_old.

family.description: OPTIONAL: digit-masked edit-signature hash (same boilerplate edit = same family).

occurrences.description: OPTIONAL: number of products carrying this German change.

tgt_published.description: OPTIONAL (month from feed): why tgt_new is missing: BAG published the target unchanged, or there is no target in the new feed.

note.description: OPTIONAL: free text for the reviewer (e.g. the SL team's ticket number).
